loss: Original bounded full-field terminal loss + 0.02 terminal pose + 1.0 direct neural-prior pose SmoothL1(beta=0.25)
selection: Most valid full-field passes; tie lowest worst-field P90 then field mean
training_grid: original Nikon audit nodes / Trepan pupil grid65
inference_protocol: One unified 35D prediction plus unchanged four model-only exact-response steps
response_backend: FP64 forward-mode automatic differentiation; NN parameters FP32
backward: Implicit Gauss-Newton at terminal pose; approximate derivative, not exact four-step trajectory derivative
attribution: Explicit readout parameterization and learning-rate fix; original terminal and direct-prior losses unchanged
reason: Keep training-feature centering/scaling explicit instead of folding them into enormous FP32 readout weights; constrain sensitive backbone update scale
architecture: One shared field CNN, four shared attention blocks, one 35D full-pose head
initialization: Same training-only ridge fit as the 24.85% initial model, with feature centering/scaling explicit rather than folded into large weights; FP32 rounding differences measured
inference_inputs: image and raw from the same archived observation packet; no labels or teacher
validation_protocol: 6000 original cases, center ABS and edge DIFF, all three below 0.07 waves; invalids fail
optimizer: All 101 FP32 tensors AdamW backbone lr=1e-07, readout lr=1e-05; same four-epoch cosine
